messages:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT: PROD: repeated GPU OOMs in gpu-serving-prod causing container restarts. Affected node group: gpu-ssd-zone1. Paged: @sre-oncall-amy.

sre-oncall-amy: Ack, I'm on it. Mateo @eng-runtime and Priya @ml-infra please join. Paging channel and starting triage.

eng-runtime-mateo: Looking at kube events + container logs now. Seeing repeated CUDA driver resets then container SIGKILL. Example log snippet:
```
[2026-05-11T02:14:05Z] runtime:error: cudaDriverReset -> signal 6, restarting container
[2026-05-11T02:14:05Z] serve:prefill: request id=abc123 tokens=98000 model=redwood-llm-large, mem spike -> oom
```

ml-infra-priya: That token count is huge. Prefill path is allocating KV cache then trying to pre-allocate full KV for long context -> fragmentation. Possible long-prompt surge. Any correlation with recent customer jobs?

support-lead-john: CS reports two customers saw 502/500 errors for long-document ingestion over the last 12m. Not system-wide but high latency + restarts for those routes.

customer-success-liz: I've notified the primary contact at Customer A and offered a short status note. They want ETA for mitigation.

sre-oncall-amy: Quick mitigation options (short list):
- throttle/cap prefill max_tokens at the router for prod routes (fast).
- route >X token requests to smaller model or CPU-backed fallback (slower but safer).
- cordon/drain worst nodes to limit noisy neighbor restarts.
- hotpatch runtime to skip KV prefill for requests above threshold (risky but targeted).

eng-runtime-mateo: I'll put a temporary router cap in place now (8192 tokens) and enable immediate fallback to cap-model-small for requests above that. Executing command:
```bash
# update routing config
curl -X POST https://router.internal/config \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","prefill_max_tokens":8192,"fallback_model":"redwood-llm-small"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```

deploy-bot: Router config change applied: route=/v1/generate prefill_max_tokens=8192 fallback_model=redwood-llm-small (change_id=cfg-20260511-1).

eng-runtime-mateo: Kicking a small restart on the three most impacted pods to clear fragmented allocations. Doing rolling restart with 30s delay.

ml-infra-priya: Observing immediate drop in new OOM events after router cap. However existing pods still show fragmented GPU memory; recommending a GC/evict of prefix cache and toggling cuDNN workspace limit on affected GPUs.

sre-oncall-amy: Priya, coordinate GC with Mateo so we don't create a cascade of restarts. John, please send a brief customer-facing message: we're applying a temporary cap to very long prompts and rolling mitigations; no data lost; ETA 30-60m.

support-lead-john: Draft: "We are experiencing GPU memory issues affecting very long prompts. We've applied a temporary limit to extremely long requests and are rolling a fix to reduce memory pressure. We expect restoration for affected requests within ~1 hour. We'll follow up with a postmortem." Shall I send?

customer-success-liz: Send now. Keep me in the loop for tone and follow-ups.

eng-runtime-mateo: Rolling a targeted hotpatch to skip KV prefill for requests >50k tokens (canary 10% -> monitor). Hotpatch command:
```bash
# apply runtime guard
kubectl set env deploy/runtime-service RUNTIME_PREFILL_THRESHOLD=50000 --record
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: runtime-service v2-hotpatch -> 10% traffic. Health checks passing for canary.

ml-infra-priya: Canary looks good at 10% for 5m. No new cudaDriverReset observed on canary nodes. Increasing to 50%.

eng-runtime-mateo: Increasing canary to 50% -> 100%. Hotpatch rolled to all runtime pods. Observed sustained reduction in OOM events.

sre-oncall-amy: Great. Marking incident as mitigated for customer impact; continuing to monitor for 1 hour. Assigning postmortem owners: eng-runtime-mateo, ml-infra-priya.

support-lead-john: Notifying customers that mitigations are active and we will send follow-up postmortem.

customer-success-liz: Customer A updated. They acknowledge and appreciate the quick mitigation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 2967001234 STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Closed for immediate paging. Postmortem required.

eng-runtime-mateo: Follow-up items:
- investigate long-context routing and add soft-reject for absurd token counts.
- better KV prefill heuristics (segment prefill vs full prealloc).
- extend alerting to detect prefill token spikes earlier.

ml-infra-priya: I'll own the kernel/cuda fragmentation analysis and propose GPU eviction improvements.

sre-oncall-amy: Thanks team. I'll file the incident ticket and set a PM for a postmortem write-up.
